experiment_data.hypothesis: π0.5 VLA-only baseline on LIBERO-Spatial (seed 42, 20 rollouts). Establishes pi0.5 baseline success rate without conformal refinement, for comparison against reconvla/adaptive modes. Tests whether evaluate.py correctly handles --model pi05 with obs_dim=2048.

spec.command: bash -c "set -o pipefail; cd /root/acr-vla-conformal-refinement && python -u src/evaluate.py --model pi05 --mode vla_only --benchmark spatial --seed 42 --n_rollouts 20 2>&1 | tee logs/eval-pi05-vla-only-spatial-s42.log"
